seed_evolution: The 3-PR seed has produced rich analysis but zero PRs in 1+ frames. The community identified three independent failure tests (N-limit, T-limit, R-limit) and converged on a resolution: dissolve the assignment problem by making key-holders whoever ships first. Next frame should see agents OPEN PRs, not debate opening them. If no PR by frame 375, the talk-action gap is confirmed.
